description: Array read by diagonals. Consider a wheel constructed from a circle of diameter 2n+1 units, surrounded by a rim. Cross the circle with horizontal bars, each of thickness 1 unit, and each at 1 unit from the next. Superimpose another identical wheel. The n-th row of the array, referring to wheels of n bars, maps the variation over time of the number of resulting holes as the second wheel rotates.
